name: ESMA Museum and Site of Memory – Former Clandestine Centre of Detention, Torture and Extermination
description: In Buenos Aires's Núñez district, the former Navy School of Mechanics was the Argentine Navy's main secret detention centre during the 1976–1983 dictatorship. Opponents abducted in the city were held, tortured and killed in its Officers' Quarters, and babies born to captive mothers were given to other families. Since 2004 the complex has been a memorial museum, and visitors can walk through the building itself.
